metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of a GCP-hosted data analysis stack. A user authenticates via Google IAP to reach a web app that acts as an MCP host. The web app queries Gemini as the AI model and calls an MCP server with read-only access to an orders view on a PostgreSQL database

elements.name: User
elements.description: Analyst accessing the web app via browser

elements.name: Google IAP
elements.description: Google Identity-Aware Proxy. Enforces authentication before forwarding requests to the web app

elements.name: Web App
elements.description: GCP-hosted web application acting as the MCP host. Sends prompts to Gemini and dispatches MCP tool calls to the MCP server

elements.name: Gemini
elements.description: Gemini model served via Vertex AI within the GCP project. Processes user prompts and drives MCP tool selection

elements.name: MCP Server
elements.description: MCP server exposing the orders view as a read-only query tool

elements.name: PostgreSQL
elements.description: PostgreSQL database on GCP hosting the orders view

elements.name: orders
elements.description: Read-only PostgreSQL view exposing order data. Accessed exclusively by the MCP server
